outputs.explanation: Panel a consists of a schematic illustrating image cropping and an example micrograph; it is not a plot showing averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel b shows schematic cell outlines and micrographs illustrating image spacing/separation, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel c shows a schematic and micrographs illustrating zoom/inset presentation, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel d shows a brightness/contrast slider schematic and grayscale micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel e shows schematic color-annotation examples and micrographs/staining images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel f shows a schematic diagram of grayscale channel overlap and grayscale micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel g shows schematic calibration scale illustrations and micrographs with intensity/pseudocolor scales, not a plot of averaged data requiring individual data points.
